activationRecovery.safeClaim: restore exact preactivation Journal state before restarting previous binary when provisional schema migration activation fails

operatorConstraint.reason: facts written during provisional candidate activation would not exist in the preactivation Journal snapshot and therefore must not be admitted before activation is accepted

limitations: This acceptance is deterministic/fault-injection evidence; the live /var/lib/ordivon/host authority remains schema v4 until the separately controlled deployment is executed.
External ingress quiescence is an operational precondition for the real schema-changing activation and is verified separately before apply.
